bottlenecksAndRemediations.title: Reverse-Proxy and Mobile Carrier NAT IP Aggregation in Rate Limiter
bottlenecksAndRemediations.description: Fastify ProcessLocalRateLimiter previously keyed client requests strictly by socket IP when unauthenticated. Under reverse proxies (Render, Cloudflare) or mobile carrier-grade NATs (Grameenphone, Banglalink, Robi), hundreds of distinct users shared a single IP bucket, triggering false-positive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.remediation: Updated ProcessLocalRateLimiter to parse 'CF-Connecting-IP' and the leftmost 'X-Forwarded-For' client IP. Added trustProxy: true to Fastify configuration. Exempted health monitoring probes (/health, /api/health, /v1/health) from rate-limiting counters to prevent monitoring alert flaps.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.verification: Phase 121 automated performance tests verify distinct IP isolation and zero-throttling on health endpoints under 500 req/sec bursts.

bottlenecksAndRemediations.title: Supabase Free Tier Direct Connection Pool Exhaustion at > 35 CCU
bottlenecksAndRemediations.description: Supabase Free tier limits PostgreSQL direct connections to 15 concurrent clients. Under 5k-10k user loads (150-300 CCU), direct connections exhaust within 400ms, causing ECONNREFUSED and HTTP 500/503 errors.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.remediation: Mandate PgBouncer transaction pooling on Supabase Pro for all workloads exceeding 35 CCU (5,000+ registered users). Transaction pooling allows 100 pooled client connections to share 15-20 backend server connections.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.verification: Documented in ADR 0121 and enforced via capacity thresholds.

bottlenecksAndRemediations.title: Submarine Cable Latency and Packet Loss to Singapore Origin from Bangladesh
bottlenecksAndRemediations.description: Direct origin round-trips from Bangladesh to Singapore datacenters take ~95ms base RTT. On mobile connections with 1.5% packet loss, TCP retransmission adds 150ms per round-trip, degrading interactive perceived performance.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.remediation: Leverage Cloudflare Dhaka POP (DAC) edge caching for Next.js static assets, PWA offline shell (/offline-shell.html), and immutable bundles. Cache hits resolve in 15-35ms locally in Bangladesh without crossing international submarine cables.
bottlenecksAndRemediations.verification: Tested via Next.js SSR & PWA offline shell load tests in Phase 121.

noExtrapolationPrinciple.rule: Do not extrapolate the previous 100-user local synthetic test into a thousands-user claim.
noExtrapolationPrinciple.scientificBasis: Local synthetic load runs execute over zero-latency IPC loopback sockets with infinite mock connection pools and zero network jitter. Real-world 1,000 to 10,000 user production traffic exhibits non-linear queuing behavior governed by Little's Law (L = λW) and Erlang C queuing models: when database connection saturation or CPU utilization exceeds 70%, latency curves inflect asymptotically toward timeout cliffs rather than scaling linearly. Capacity boundaries must be empirically verified on hosted staging with network emulation.
